Class CollectionProjectionMapper

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.read.CollectionProjectionMapper
@Internal public final class CollectionProjectionMapper extends Object
Centralized projection mapping for Nitrite operations. Handles single-field, multi-field, and DTO projections from document cursors.
Since:
5.2.0
